traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): plants herbs, perennial.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs, scapose, acaulescent, from a branched woody rootstock (herbaceous above ground).

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves in basal rosettes.

traits.cauline_leaves.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): scapes leafless, enclosed at the apex by a tubular sheath.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves sessile.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade linear to linear-spatulate (lanceolate outside the flora).

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): margins entire.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences solitary, apical, dense hemispheric heads of scorpioid cymes, each surrounded by an involucre of scarious bracts.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): one head at the apex of each scape.

traits.bract_form.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): involucre of scarious (dry, papery) bracts.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pedicels absent or present (short); 2 mm is an estimate for 'short'.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits dry, enclosed in the persistent calyx, opening transversely (a lid): read as capsule, as FOC calls the family's fruits.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits enclosed in persistent calyces.

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): anthers included.

traits.perianth_fused.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals slightly connate at the base.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Armeria (Lefebvre & Vekemans) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): styles 5, free, hairy below.
